note: Curated service-matchable feed. CVSS v3.1 and EPSS fetched live at build time (NVD API 2.0 / FIRST EPSS API); KEV membership matched against the CISA KEV catalog JSON. Affected ranges from the published advisories cited per entry.

entries.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor — remote shell on port 6200
entries.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 distributed between 2011-06-30 and 2011-07-03 contains a backdoor that opens a root shell on port 6200/tcp when a smiley-face ':)' is sent in the FTP username. Public Metasploit module exists.
entries.remediation: Replace the 2.3.4 build with a verified upstream release (2.3.5+); rotate credentials on the host; audit for historic compromise.
entries.source: NVD CVE-2011-2523; Tenable CVSS v3 9.8; Metasploit module

entries.title: ProFTPD TELNET IAC stack overflow — remote code execution
entries.description: Multiple stack-based buffer overflows in pr_netio_telnet_gets in netio.c in ProFTPD before 1.3.3c allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via TELNET IAC escape characters.
entries.remediation: Upgrade ProFTPD to 1.3.3c or later (the fixed upstream release).
entries.source: NVD CVE-2010-4221; Tenable Nessus 70446 CVSS v3 9.8

entries.title: ProFTPD 1.3.3c backdoor — unauthorized access
entries.description: A malicious backdoor was embedded in the official ProFTPD 1.3.3c source tarball distributed between 2010-11-28 and 2010-12-02. Public Metasploit module exists (ProFTPD 1.3.3c Backdoor Command Execution).
entries.remediation: Rebuild from a verified upstream 1.3.3d+ source; rotate credentials; audit for historic compromise.
entries.source: NVD CVE-2010-20103; Aqua CVSS 3.1 9.8; Metasploit module

entries.title: Apache HTTP Server path traversal & code disclosure
entries.description: Path traversal and file disclosure flaw in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49. Actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV). Can lead to RCE when CGI scripts are enabled.
entries.remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later.

entries.title: Apache HTTP Server path traversal (41773 bypass)
entries.description: A second, more aggressive path-traversal (incomplete fix of CVE-2021-41773) in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50 — could leak executable files outside the document root. Actively exploited (CISA KEV).
entries.remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later.

entries.title: OpenSSH ssh-agent PKCS#11 RCE
entries.description: The PKCS#11 feature in ssh-agent in OpenSSH 5.9 through 9.3p1 has an insufficiently trustworthy search path, leading to remote code execution if an agent is forwarded to an attacker-controlled host.
entries.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.3p2 or later; avoid forwarding agents to untrusted hosts.
entries.source: NVD CVE-2023-38408 (CVSS 9.8 per Aqua/NVD); OpenSSH release notes

entries.title: regreSSHion — OpenSSH signal handler race condition RCE
entries.description: Signal handler race condition (SIGALRM) in OpenSSH server 8.5p1 through 9.7p1 allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.

entries.title: Heartbleed — OpenSSL TLS heartbeat memory disclosure
entries.description: The TLS/DTLS heartbeat read in OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1g discloses up to 64KB of server process memory (private keys, session tickets, credentials). CISA KEV.
entries.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1h+ (1.0.2/1.1.1 unaffected); rotate private keys and session credentials.

entries.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset — denial-of-service amplification
entries.description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a client to rapidly cancel streams, forcing the server to allocate/deallocate state — an unauthenticated DoS amplification against unpatched HTTP/2 stacks. Mass-exploited (CISA KEV).
entries.remediation: Apply the vendor's October 2023 HTTP/2 patch/limits (e.g. nginx 1.25.3+, Apache 2.4.58+, httpd max-connection resets).
